_doc: Optional per-kind overrides (spec 2026-11-03 §3). save_has: userState fields that identify the kind in the save (prefab ids are opaque); state: save field -> one-vocabulary state key ([field, 'bool' | {value: state, '*': default}]); area: name stem for an area where this kind is the main one; markers: state -> frame marker nav can walk to. A kind without an entry still works (raw fields only; named from the log). _toward: seeded screen directions between frame nodes (D185 farm frame; learned edges replace them). node: the graph node a detection/bubble of this kind means on the frame (closest node). bubbles: bubble kinds only this kind shows. daily: state a new game day resets (watering), applied when today's log is a newer day than the save. _triggers: log triggers that prove which object a click used (no target= line: the farmhouse door). _lists: named value lists goals use as $params (flowers: docs/world/items/crops.md, sold to Violet's Violets or named Flower).
